agencies.name: American Probation and Parole Association
agencies.description: Leading professional membership association for the community corrections field; members across government and private sector in the U.S., Canada, and other countries.

agencies.name: American Youth Policy Forum
agencies.description: Nonprofit, nonpartisan professional development org providing learning opportunities for policy leaders, practitioners, and researchers on education, youth, and workforce policy.

agencies.name: Association of Probation Officers of Wielkopolska
agencies.description: Polish regional probation officers' association (Wielkopolska district); grown from 49 to 260+ members across 8 districts since 1999.

agencies.name: Brookings Institution
agencies.description: Nonprofit public policy organization (Washington, DC) conducting research on local, national, and global problems; traces to the 1916 Institute for Government Research.

agencies.name: Bureau of Justice Assistance
agencies.description: Created in 1984 to reduce violent crime and reform the justice system; provides training, technical assistance, and resources to state/local/tribal justice partners.

agencies.name: Bureau of Justice Statistics
agencies.description: DOJ's primary statistical agency; collects and disseminates data on crime, offenders, victims, and justice system operations; supports state/local/tribal statistical capacity.

agencies.name: Canadian Training Institute
agencies.description: National voluntary organization; has trained 5,000+ individuals; supports safe customer service environments and staff/volunteer training on family violence, mental health, addictions, reentry.

agencies.name: Center on Juvenile/Criminal Justice
agencies.description: Nonprofit, nonpartisan org focused on reducing reliance on incarceration; provides direct services, policy research, advocacy, and public education.

agencies.name: Community Corrections Collaborative Network
agencies.description: Develops relationships with federal and NGO partners to inform community corrections policy; produces position papers, surveys, and educational media.

agencies.name: Community Justice Exchange
agencies.description: Develops tactical interventions and organizing tools to end criminalization, incarceration, surveillance, and detention; supports community-based organizations nationally.

agencies.name: Community Resources for Justice
agencies.description: Result of mergers among organizations focused on crime prevention, direct aid to incarcerated/formerly incarcerated people, and services for adults with developmental disabilities.

agencies.name: Conference of European Probation
agencies.description: Promotes social inclusion of offenders through community sanctions (probation, community service, mediation); works to professionalize probation nationally and across Europe.

agencies.name: Correctional Management Institute of Texas
agencies.description: Develops and delivers professional education, management development, and specialized training for juvenile and adult community/institutional corrections personnel.

agencies.name: Corrections.com
agencies.description: Online brand for the global corrections community; daily news plus a vendor intelligence database; supports professional communication and collaboration.

agencies.name: Corrections Software Solutions
agencies.description: Acronym: CSS

agencies.name: Criminal Justice Testing and Evaluation Consortium
agencies.description: NIJ program using research-based methodologies to enhance law enforcement, courts, and corrections agency capabilities.

agencies.name: Eisenhower Foundation
agencies.description: DC-based continuation of the Kerner and Eisenhower Violence Commissions; focused on reducing inequality/poverty and replicating evidence-based solutions for underserved communities.

agencies.name: International Community Corrections Association
agencies.description: Aims to change public perception of justice-involved individuals, reduce reliance on incarceration/supervision, and promote evidence-informed community-based treatment.

agencies.name: International Corrections and Prisons Association
agencies.description: Global organization (70+ countries) advancing professional and humane corrections through membership, conferences, chapters, and strategic planning support.

agencies.name: Manhattan Institute
agencies.description: Community of scholars, journalists, activists, and civic leaders focused on advancing opportunity, individual liberty, and rule of law.

agencies.name: National Criminal Justice Reference Service
agencies.description: Federally funded resource (est. 1972) offering justice and drug-related information supporting research, policy, and program development worldwide.
agencies.notes: Source page's homepage link was a placeholder (#), not a live URL — left blank rather than guessing.

agencies.name: National Institute of Corrections
agencies.description: Only federal agency with a legislative mandate (Public Law 93-415) to provide specialized services to corrections nationally; known for partnerships and interagency agreements.

agencies.name: National Institute of Justice
agencies.description: Focuses on research, development, and evaluation of crime control and justice issues; funds research and technology assistance, publishes findings.

agencies.name: NCTI
agencies.description: Tagline: A Resource for Success

agencies.name: Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention
agencies.description: Established under the Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention Act of 1974; supports state/local efforts to prevent delinquency and improve juvenile justice systems.

agencies.name: Public/Private Ventures Legacy Collection
agencies.description: Former nonprofit social research/policy org (disbanded 2012); publications archived with the Foundation Center's IssueLab.

agencies.name: U.S. Department of Justice
agencies.description: 40+ component organizations, 115,000+ employees; headquartered at the Robert F. Kennedy Building; field offices across all U.S. states/territories and 50+ countries.

agencies.name: Urban Institute
agencies.description: 50+ year nonprofit research organization providing data/evidence to advance upward mobility and equity for changemakers.
